 CARSON DALY NAMED CO-ANCHOR OF ‘SATURDAY TODAY’
 Nov 05, 2026 
 Katie Katz

 Featured , TODAY 
 Daly Expands His Role at ‘TODAY’ While Continuing as Weekday Co-Host 
 Daly Debuts Alongside Co-Anchor Laura Jarrett Saturday, November 7 
 NEW YORK – November 5, 2026 –  Carson Daly has been named co-anchor of NBC News’  Saturday TODAY . He will make his official debut alongside co-anchor Laura Jarrett, feature anchor Joe Fryer and meteorologist Angie Lassman this Saturday, November 7.
 In his expanded role, Daly will continue to co-host  TODAY  weekdays while joining the Saturday morning team, bringing his trademark warmth, versatility and trusted voice to viewers live, six days a week. 
 Daly will also continue to host and executive produce NBC’s Emmy Award-winning competition series  The Voice , a role he has held since the show’s premiere in 2011. Additionally, he serves as executive producer of the newest edition of the franchise,  The Voice: Celebrity .
 “Carson has been an integral part of the  TODAY  family for the past 13 years, and we are thrilled that our viewers get to spend one more day of the week with him,” said Libby Leist, Executive Vice President of TODAY and Lifestyle. “Carson and Laura make a great team, and we can’t wait for this fresh new chapter of  Saturday TODAY .”
 “I’m thrilled to add  Saturday TODAY  to my weekday morning schedule. My kids asked if I’ll still make pancakes. I told them yes, but I’ll be making them for Laura, Joe and Angie instead,” Daly said. “I’m equal parts grateful and excited for this opportunity.”
 Daly joined  TODAY  in 2013 as host of the Orange Room, the show’s digital and social media hub, and has since become known for his signature Pop Start segment, covering the latest in pop culture news. During his tenure, he has conducted headline-making interviews with prominent figures across music, sports and entertainment, as well as political and medical newsmakers and everyday heroes. He has also been a passionate advocate for mental health awareness, using his platform to spotlight important conversations and personal stories. He serves on the Board of Directors for the nonprofit organization Project Healthy Minds.
 Daly previously hosted NBC’s successful late-night series  Last Call with Carson Daly , which concluded in 2019 after 18 seasons and 2,000 episodes. Known for its documentary-style storytelling, the acclaimed series featured a star-studded lineup of guests including Robin Williams, Elton John, Angelina Jolie, Dave Chappelle and Alicia Keys.
 Earlier in his career, Daly co-created, hosted and executive produced MTV’s  Total Request Live  ( TRL ), transforming the music video countdown into a cultural phenomenon and a must-stop destination for artists including Beyoncé, Britney Spears, Justin Timberlake, Eminem and Christina Aguilera.
 Matt Carluccio serves as executive producer of the weekend editions of  TODAY .   Saturday TODAY  airs Saturday mornings on NBC.
